title: Read texts police say Kirk shooting suspect and former roommate exchanged, which prosecutors could use as key evidence | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

Tyler Robinson, the suspect in the Septemberkillingof conservative activist Charlie Kirk, is in court this week for a multiday hearing where Utah prosecutors are expected to preview some of their evidence in the case.

Texts that Robinson allegedly sent to his then-roommate the day of the shooting — discussing a rifle,possible motive and other detailson the planning surrounding the event — are expected to be key evidence in the state’s case. The messages had previously been made public in charging documents, which also refer to the roommate as Robinson’s romantic partner, last year.
